instruction: Set the default font size to 14 points for all new documents in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font size for LibreOffice Writer to 14 points. The evaluator checks the LibreOffice configuration file to verify that the StandardHeight setting under DefaultFont is set to '14'. Similar difficulty to original task as it involves navigating to the same settings menu.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) which contains default font settings
Metric logic correctly parses XML and searches for the StandardHeight property under /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont path
Expected value (14) matches the instruction requirement for 14-point font size
Comparison logic is correct: converts expected integer to string and compares with XML text content
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction
State accessibility: configuration file is persistent and accessible after user completes the task, no postconfig needed
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0 if file is missing or XML parsing fails
Parameter handling is correct: directly accesses rules['font_size'] as expected when type='rule'
